strongest_angle: Analyze the late October and early November 2026 amicus briefs filed by the Human Consent Foundation, WME, CAA, and prominent artists supporting The New York Times against OpenAI and Microsoft.

key_facts.fact: On October 30, 2026, the Human Consent Foundation backed by Cate Blanchett filed an amicus brief in the New York Times copyright lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft.
On Friday night, November 2026, talent agency WME filed an amicus brief in the legal case regarding IP management in the AI era against OpenAI and Microsoft.
The amici curiae brief filed by the Human Consent Foundation includes Creative Artists Agency, LLC, Music Artists Coalition, National Association of Voice Actors, Steven Soderbergh, and Nick Hexum.
